summary: The round-8 major is fixed. base_fea now applies +-1860/(z_bhi - z_blo) = +-90.7 N over the real 20.5 mm bearing spacing (z_blo 20, z_bhi 40.5), and the report shows My 1843 N*mm against the 1.86 N*m target (2 x [805 N*mm shoulder torque + 0.486 kg x 9.81 x 25 mm = 119 N*mm]). The hot spot sits on the bearing tower, where the load enters. The round-8 minors are also closed: turntable couples of 1010 N*mm give a net My of 1865 N*mm, the forearm takes 3.1 N per site (6.2 N against 2 x 300.4 g = 5.89 N), the why texts name the far-end servos, and teardrops now appear on the link tab pilots and the heat-set pivot holes (visible in part_upper_arm_sheet FRONT). The remaining items are documentation nits, carried-over engine minors, and the known thin stall margin on the upper arm.

findings.issue: DESIGN.md's Strength table gives base_fea deflection as 0.11 mm, but report.json has 0.129 mm. The turntable row says 0.23 mm against a report value of 0.239, which rounds to 0.24. Stale by a small amount. Both are still under the 0.3 mm limit.
findings.fix: Update the base_fea row to 0.13 mm and the turntable_fea row to 0.24 mm.

findings.issue: For the record: upper_arm_stall_fea p99.9 is 13.34 MPa against 16 MPa (margin 1.20). The peak is 18.95 MPa at the elbow servo window frame in plate A. That is on the load path, and fea_upper_arm_stall_fea.png shows it there. This is the thinnest margin on the arm, and the DS32xx tab holes are still UNVERIFIED in the catalog.
findings.fix: Test-fit a real DS3225/DS3218 in a printed yoke_r before printing the rest (already in DESIGN.md Risks).

findings.issue: Carried over: the pwr_yaw and sig_yaw routes end at base.yaw_boss, but the engine still appends the servo origin as the last point, so the drawn lead ends inside the MG996R case.
findings.fix: Engine: end a lead at the servo's cable-boss point instead of its origin (general fix).

findings.issue: Carried over: kerf/electrical.py still leaves the ATO fuse's cold resistance and the holder lead out of each fused run's loop resistance. The margin is still positive.
findings.fix: Engine: add the fuse cold resistance and the holder lead to each fused run.

findings.issue: Carried over: the optional 45 degree chamfer under the overhanging side of the floor tie bridge was not done.
findings.fix: Optional: chamfer the underside of the bridge block at 45 degrees.

findings.issue: Carried over: 12.6 % of the surface prints on support (cosmetic). Gripper is at 15.8 %, already accepted in DESIGN.md.
findings.fix: Optional: set the column flush with one side of the foot.

findings.issue: Carried over and accepted: the Nano, the WAGO splices and the fuse holders sit loose on the desk.
findings.fix: None required; an electronics tray on the rear pad would be tidier.
